newsitem.title: USA: Haverty Furniture Nov same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Haverty Furniture Nov same-store sales up.

text.p: Haverty Furniture Cos said its same-store sales for the month ending November 30 -- or sales at stores open more than one year -- rose 9.1 percent amid strong demand for the company's furniture.
The company said its total November sales rose 15.7 percent to $47.1 million from $40.7 million a year ago.
Same-store sales for the year-to-date were up 5.2 percent, while total sales for the same period were up 16.6 percent to $416.3 million from $357.2 million a year before, it said.
